text:
jamal: Heads up — starting ~12:30 UTC we're seeing remote_write backpressure from prom-relay cluster. 503s and write throttles.

nina: saw that, also scrape errors increasing on node-exporter for gpu-pool nodes :eyes:

sre-oncall: alerted via pagerduty, collecting logs now. what's the current remote_write queue depth?

jamal: queue_depth ~ 87k on relay-2, latency P95 1.2s -> spikes to 12s. remote_write >5xx 14%.

maria: logs show the relabel config applied yesterday could be exploding cardinality — extra label "pod_revision" from sidecar injector.

lee: can you paste the relabel config?

maria: ```yaml
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_revision]
  target_label: pod_revision
  action: replace
```

nina: that will add revision on every deploy -> high churn. we need to drop it for node-exporter targets.

sre-oncall: rolling back relabel on promjob/gpu-pool to drop pod_revision, patching now.

ops-bot: Deploy started by @sre-oncall: patch(prometheus, promjob/gpu-pool) (ID: d-3421)

jamal: after patch relay-2 queue_depth dropping to 12k, remote_write 5xx down to 1.8% :thumbsup:

maria: we should add relabel rules to only keep pod_revision when job=app, not node-exporter. I'll open PR for a whitelist.

lee: also raising remote_write timeout from 10s -> 15s for relay-2 to help with transient TLS handshakes to cortex.

nina: noted — will update alert PrometheusRemoteWriteHighErrorRate threshold to 5% and add a short runbook for debugging queue_depth.

sre-oncall: closing incident if stable for 15m. keeping monitoring dashboards pinned. :lock_with_ink_pen:

ops-bot: Deploy succeeded (d-3421) in 34s

jamal: thanks all, leaving a note in #postmortems to cover relabel QA, test data with cardinality, and deploy gating.
